name: andpayments
description: Merchant Payments Dashboard — NestJS + React + PostgreSQL

scripts.build: npm run build -w @andpayments/api && npm run build -w @andpayments/web
scripts.db:local:init: initdb -D .pgdata -U andpayments --auth=trust --encoding=UTF8 && npm run db:local:start && createdb -h localhost -p 5433 -U andpayments andpayments && createdb -h localhost -p 5433 -U andpayments andpayments_test
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @andpayments/api && npm run lint -w @andpayments/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @andpayments/api && npm run typecheck -w @andpayments/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
